svg.title: Sequence diagram. The agent sends analyze_prompt to zn-gate on your machine, which allows or blocks it. Then check_tool_call, which allows the call with secrets masked or blocks it. The agent runs the tool. The output comes back through check_tool_result or shield, and zn-gate returns it with secrets redacted, or neutralized if it carries an injection.
svg.text: allow, or block with the rule that fired
allow with secrets masked, or block
neutralized if it carries an injection
